sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: hydrolyse
steps.note: Immobilised lactase splits lactose into equal glucose and galactose.

steps.name: isomerise
steps.note: By L-arabinose isomerase (thermophile) or alkaline calcium hydroxide; about 30 % converts in an example.

steps.name: fractionate
steps.note: By chromatography, or by fermenting the glucose away.
